attr.title: Dr Rustario vs Rustris
attr.desc: Two falling-block puzzle games on one engine: a virus-busting pill dropper and a line-clearing tetromino game, each in NES, SNES, N64 and modern themes. Play either, mix them in a match, or alternate them stage by stage in a playlist.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Config and high scores are saved in the port folder.
